name: Extnify Shipping Rules for WooCommerce
author: extnify

sections.description:
Extnify Shipping Rules for WooCommerce is a lightweight and easy-to-use shipping rules plugin that helps you create custom shipping methods with flexible pricing. Create unlimited shipping methods, restrict them by WooCommerce shipping zones, and calculate shipping costs using flat rates or subtotal-based pricing.

Features

  • Unlimited Shipping Methods — Create as many shipping methods as your store needs.
  • Shipping Zone Rules — Restrict each shipping method to a specific WooCommerce shipping zone.
  • Flexible Shipping Rates — Calculate shipping using a Flat Amount, Subtotal, or Subtotal + Tax.
  • Range-Based Pricing — Set different shipping rates based on cart subtotal ranges.
  • Tax Class — Configure the applicable tax class for each shipping method.
  • Method Ordering — Control the display order of your shipping methods.
  • Easy Method Management — Enable, disable, copy, delete, and bulk-save shipping methods.

Privacy

Extnify Shipping Rules makes no external requests and collects no data. All shipping rules and calculations run directly on your WooCommerce store.

Need More Shipping Rules?

For more complex shipping requirements, Extnify Shipping Rules Pro adds product, category and manufacturer rules, advanced conditions, dimensional and volumetric weight calculations, distance-based rates, method grouping, CSV import/export, custom pricing options, and more.

Extnify Shipping Rules is built by Extnify, the developer behind X-ShippingPro for OpenCart.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ (or install via the Plugins screen).
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Extnify Shipping Rules to configure your shipping methods.
  5. Add Extnify Shipping Rules to a shipping zone under WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Zones so your methods appear at checkout.
sections.faq:
Does this send any data anywhere?

No. Extnify Shipping Rules makes no external calls and stores everything locally in your database.

Can I upgrade to Pro without losing my settings?

Yes. Extnify Shipping Rules and Extnify Shipping Rules Pro share the same data, so your configured methods
carry over automatically.
